company.summary: Glow 是一家 AI 驱动的终端安全公司，采用预防优先的方式重塑企业终端安全。公司由安全领域资深人士和连续创业者创立，认为 AI 使被动安全策略失效，因此从第一性原理重建终端保护。

Glow, the AI-powered endpoint security company, today emerged from stealth with $180 million in funding at a $1.2 billion valuation to redefine how enterprises secure the modern endpoint with a prevention-first approach.

Glow was founded by security veterans and repeat founders with one shared conviction: AI made reactive security a losing game. We're rebuilding endpoint protection - the most attacked surface in the enterprise - from first principles.

evidence_refs.quote: Glow is building an endpoint security platform that helps enterprises monitor and control the software, AI agents, and developer tools running on employee devices. The startup said the platform uses specialized AI agents to continuously map enterprise environments, assess risk in real time, and enforce security policies.

Glow’s platform, Tiger said, has already prevented malicious npm packages, third-party software components used to build applications, from being installed in customer environments, identified AI agents attempting to pull in such software, and detected employee devices where endpoint detection and response tools were missing or operating with reduced functionality.

comparisons.name: CrowdStrike
comparisons.core_difference: 现有终端检测与响应产品主要关注威胁出现后的检测，而 Glow 设计为从一开始就防止有风险的软件、AI 代理和开发者工具进入企业环境。

evidence_refs.quote: Tiger said existing endpoint detection and response products focus primarily on detecting threats after they emerge, whereas Glow is designed to prevent risky software, AI agents, and developer tools from entering enterprise environments in the first place.

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是 AI 时代终端安全范式的转变：随着企业部署 AI 工具、攻击者利用生成式 AI 自动化攻击，传统终端检测与响应产品主要关注威胁出现后的检测，而 Glow 采用预防优先的方式，从一开始就防止有风险的软件、AI 代理和开发者工具进入企业环境。当前 12 亿美元估值和 1.8 亿美元融资所依赖的已验证信号包括：公司已结束隐身模式、拥有付费客户（涵盖医疗、零售和金融服务行业）、平台已实际阻止恶意 npm 包安装并检测到缺失终端检测与响应工具的设备。判断的证据边界在于：公司未披露收入指标和客户名称及数量，AI 原生终端安全平台能否成为独立品类仍有待观察，企业才刚刚开始应对日益强大的 AI 模型带来的安全影响。
validated_signals: 公司已结束隐身模式并完成 1.8 亿美元融资，估值 12 亿美元
公司已拥有付费客户，涵盖医疗、零售和金融服务行业
平台已阻止恶意 npm 包安装到客户环境
平台已识别试图拉入恶意软件的 AI 代理
平台已检测到缺少终端检测与响应工具或功能降低的员工设备
公司员工近 100 人，约 70% 在以色列，其余在美国
